final: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(p.disp_id) AS client_count FROM district AS d LEFT JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id LEFT JOIN disp AS p ON p.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3), totals AS (SELECT district_id, region, client_count, SUM(client_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_total, SUM(client_count) OVER () AS overall_total FROM district_counts) SELECT district_id, region, client_count, 1.0 * client_count / region_total AS region_share, 1.0 * client_count / overall_total AS overall_share FROM totals ORDER BY overall_share DESC, district_id LIMIT 10
